purpose: Apply observed UI/UX critique principles to CBGPU; this is an independent implementation, not the creator's design or endorsement.

coverage.method: Public video, Korean captions where available, local CPU transcription and sampled frames across each video. Automated captions/transcripts may be inaccurate.
coverage.visual_method: Four sampled frames across each video inspected in contact sheets; the frame sequence samples the full timeline every eight seconds. This is not real-time playback of every frame.

principles.rule: Use clear visual hierarchy; distinguish the main action, supporting actions and information.
principles.application: Larger readable titles and body text; one audience-specific primary action; secondary controls remain quiet.

principles.rule: Avoid stacking decorative glass, borders, cards and shadows around every element.
principles.application: Flatten the greeting and account area; retain surfaces only for independently actionable services and work.

principles.rule: Use spacing to explain grouping, rather than creating arbitrary empty regions.
principles.application: Consistent section rhythm and smaller internal gaps; shared alignment across cards and headings.

principles.rule: Motion should communicate the result of an action before it acts as decoration.
principles.application: Visible and accessible favorite-save feedback, pressed/focus states, real loading/error states and reduced-motion support.

principles.rule: Keep a repeatable module structure even when text and numbers get long.
principles.application: Stable project title/domain/status ordering, wrapping instead of clipping, mobile touch targets.

principles.rule: Balance strong and quiet sections instead of competing decorative treatments everywhere.
principles.application: Confident introductory type with calm task lists and low-emphasis supporting links.

principles.rule: Improve the user's task and preserve product policy; generic patterns do not justify invented capabilities.
principles.application: Retain audience-only services, real authentication rules, original time/weather greetings, and honest deployment state.

principles.rule: Show actual task status; do not mistake a decorative dashboard for a usable workflow.
principles.application: Developer home reads shared server projects and actual Compose deployment state; failed deployments are not labelled successful. Refresh while visible every thirty seconds.

principles.rule: Let a strong heading establish a section instead of adding repeated explanatory boxes.
principles.application: Keep necessary actionable surfaces, remove empty personal-work blocks for guests and make the start guide a plain text section.
